name: language-rooting
body:
Language rooting in the ingestor — the net-new code for the `Language` node and rooted FQNs. It adds `NodeKind::Language` (src/graph.rs) plus the DB label and the `Contains` rel pair `(Language, Module)` (src/load.rs `create_schema` / `spec_rel_pairs`, and the write-time pair check in src/ingest.rs `valid_contains_pair`); materialises one `Language` node per `lang_switch` stream in `apg.ingest.ingest` and roots each module FQN with `<language-id>.`; roots every declaration whose `parent` is a module before `render_function_fqns` / struct insertion so symbols inherit the root; wires `Language —Contains→ Module`; and lets the graph.jsonl export carry the Language records (`apg.load.write_graph_jsonl`).

The frontends are unchanged — they emit facts only and never a Language record. Within-language collision handling (module-vs-type shadowing, the same-kind `claim` panic, `shadowed_modules`/`shadowed_functions`) is untouched; only the cross-language case is removed, by the disjoint language roots.

Both design points are PINNED (see requirements.note.language-rooting-open-points): the root id string is the `lang_switch` id verbatim (`go`/`java`/`cpp`/`rust`/`ts`/`js`/`csharp`/`py`/`md`), and the `Language` node's own FQN is the bare id (e.g. `rust`).

This component does not exist yet and is not in the scanned graph, so its `implemented-by` anchors are the planned Implementation nodes `rust.apg.graph.NodeKind.Language` (Struct) and `rust.apg.ingest.root_module_fqn` (Function) — graded Pending until the branch re-scan realizes them, the same planned-anchor state as solution.component.markdown-frontend / python-frontend / rust-manifest-discovery.
